4480f357-0988-4eac-9942-abc53c7acdc9.title: Perdu
4480f357-0988-4eac-9942-abc53c7acdc9.text: Hello. I'm afraid I haven't got anything for you today.

options.text: Who are you and what do you sell?
About items that break when people kill me...

e8a27386-5272-4797-8183-aa8816f91d05.title: <player>
e8a27386-5272-4797-8183-aa8816f91d05.text: About items that break when people kill me...

90081efb-277c-43a9-9617-ce176cd4f133.title: Perdu
90081efb-277c-43a9-9617-ce176cd4f133.text:
Oh yes, some items do break specially when you're killed
by your rivals. And if you die in the deep Wilderness,
they vanish altogether.

options.text: Can you stop them vanishing in deep Wilderness?

fd2bf6f2-2ee9-46eb-8a28-168fcb2225b6.title: <player>
fd2bf6f2-2ee9-46eb-8a28-168fcb2225b6.text: Can you stop them vanishing in deep Wilderness?

04f0143e-d514-4f4b-a788-ac47e1102db4.title: <player>
04f0143e-d514-4f4b-a788-ac47e1102db4.text:
I can lock them to you so they won't vanish on death
in deep Wilderness, yes. I'll want some money for my
services, though, and you'll need to bring me a Trouver
Parchment.

01ea029f-ff03-4678-a314-0a24768356bb.text:
Perdu tells you about a merchant in the desert who
sells special scrolls called Trouver Parchments.

012b7e67-792b-4f65-8585-64221540c64e.title: <player>
012b7e67-792b-4f65-8585-64221540c64e.text:
You'll find her south-east of Al Kharid, where people
play a game called Last Man Standing. Bring the
parchment here, then show me the item you want to
lock.

f752a606-8d38-434e-8364-6ee637ff8f90.title: <player>
f752a606-8d38-434e-8364-6ee637ff8f90.text: Who are you and what do you sell?

7304df15-d70c-4189-9f6f-5e7236cf4d3c.title: Perdu
7304df15-d70c-4189-9f6f-5e7236cf4d3c.text:
My name's Perdu, and I'm from the great dwarven
city of Keldagrim, under the mountains.

cc830fc5-8e9d-46eb-90e2-ebf19b181aab.title: Perdu
cc830fc5-8e9d-46eb-90e2-ebf19b181aab.text:
In my travels, sometimes I find stuff that people might
need, or that they might have lost. So I keep it, and I
offer to sell it back.

64a741c5-ae2a-4851-b82f-0ee811d1734f.title: Perdu
64a741c5-ae2a-4851-b82f-0ee811d1734f.text:
It's always an item they could have got back elsewhere,
maybe for free, or maybe for less money, but I'm
saving them a journey so I'm entitled to charge a fee.

90bf0404-e0ee-4ae1-b8f7-a02c776c9312.title: Perdu
90bf0404-e0ee-4ae1-b8f7-a02c776c9312.text:
For a fee, yes.
Just show me the broken item

4695122e-7e67-4ec1-be1e-1aa992260a72.title: Perdu
4695122e-7e67-4ec1-be1e-1aa992260a72.text:
It seems you're missing out on some valuable
experience. Would you like it?

982a0b50-d4d2-40c8-821c-ae920d13c6bd.text:
You are owed 500 Smithing XP and 500 Crafting XP
from Prince Ali Rescue.

d59936d4-72aa-4e12-a7a8-22c77acbc141.text:
You are owed 500 Runecraft XP
from Rune Mysteries.

1ddc6db0-30f9-46fe-a4b4-e9d429ae3f55.text:
You are owed 1,000 Firemaking XP
from Clock Tower.

9c2c94a8-32f4-40ac-a770-600516b8185e.text:
You are owed 1,500 Woodcutting XP and 1,500 Crafting XP
from Lost City.
